caption:
Figure 2. Framework of our proposed Relation-aware Intra-modal Matching (RIM) Network. We first explore Stable Diffusion model and
SAM to construct image-modal reference features, then we conduct relation-aware matching between region features and reference features
based on ranking distribution. The matching is established in the all-purpose feature spaces of DINOv2.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed both initial draft and final RIM framework, read the source caption and all independent pair observations. Original SAM input, DINOv2 region branch, vocabulary-to-Stable-Diffusion reference branch, attention/mask pathway, Top-N/agent/ranking modules, distributions and chair output remain intact. The initial incorrect d color and added inter-header arrows are absent: the final d/c/s explanation is neutral gray and the three headers add no connections. All scientific source pixels are independently replayed; new permutation explanation follows the visible source labels, without inventing histogram quantities.
